expectations.evidence: Does NOT use animate.enter HTML attribute. Invents CSS selectors .item:is(.animate\\.enter) claiming Angular adds this class -- this is not a real Angular mechanism. No animate.enter="className" attribute in the template
Does NOT use animate.leave HTML attribute. Invents CSS selector .item:is(.animate\\.leave) -- this is not how Angular's animate.leave works. No animate.leave="className" attribute in the template
@keyframes fade-slide-in (enter) and @keyframes fade-slide-out (leave) defined in CSS
animation-delay: calc(var(--index, 0) * 60ms) for enter and calc(var(--index, 0) * 40ms) for leave with [style.--index]="i"
@for (item of items(); track item.id; let i = $index) used for list rendering
